$notes.purpose: The complete set of read-only Microsoft Graph scopes this tool uses. Read by PowerShell (Get-CHSIRequiredScope) and by the browser app's MSAL configuration, so the consent screen, the docs and the report's provenance table can never describe different things.
$notes.rule: Every scope here ends in .Read or .Read.All. A test in each language fails the build if a write scope is ever added.
$notes.adminConsent: All of these require admin consent. Because they are DELEGATED permissions rather than application permissions, tenant-wide consent does not require Global Administrator: Privileged Role Administrator, Cloud Application Administrator and Application Administrator can all grant it. The documented restriction on the latter two covers Microsoft Graph app roles, which this tool never requests.
$notes.keys: Keys beginning with $ are documentation and are stripped on load.

scopes.purpose: Tenant identity, verified domains, and the subscribed SKU inventory that the whole report is built on.
Directory objects and role assignments, used to confirm the running identity is a reader and to resolve license assignment.
Per-user account state and license assignment: the basis for seat-level waste analysis.
Sign-in activity for the never-signed-in and inactive waste categories. Also requires Entra ID P1 on the tenant; without it Graph returns 403 for the entire user query.
Secure Score, its 90-day history, peer benchmarks, and the control-level status that proves whether a licensed security feature is actually deployed.
